Step inside and enjoy a beautifully updated kitchen, ideal for everyday living and entertaining. The property is in excellent condition and ready for its new owners to move right in! Additional highlights include two covered parking spaces and access to fantastic community amenities, including a clubhouse, two swimming pools, and a basketball court.
